newsitem.title: USA: AA CARGO CARRIES RECORD JULY TRAFFIC.
newsitem.headline: AA CARGO CARRIES RECORD JULY TRAFFIC.

text.p: American Airlines had its best ever July for cargo traffic, says vice president of cargo sales Mark Najarian.
Traffic was up four percent over July 1996 levels with all markets showing strength, he told Reuters.

He said the increase was achieved even though American has reduced capacity. The airline is retiring McDonnell Douglas DC-10s and selling MD-11 jetliners, replacing them in many cases with smaller Boeing 767-300 aircraft.
Najarian said final July traffic statistics will be released shortly. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
